description: Record a Vim macro from a sequence of keystrokes. Claude will translate natural language descriptions to Vim commands.

execute.description: Whether to execute the macro immediately after recording (default: true)

macro_sequence.description: The Vim keystroke sequence to record as a macro (e.g., "0gUwj2j" to go to start of line, uppercase word, go down 3 lines)

register.description: Register to save the macro in (default: "q"). Must be a single letter a-z or digit 0-9

name: vim_record_macro
